extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: tower CPU air cooler with 120 mm fan, approx. 125 x 90 x 162 mm
extras.notes: stands on its copper base plate; aluminium base block with mounting bridge and spring screws, four U-shaped copper heat pipes through a stack of aluminium fins with round caps on top, lavender top plate; 120 mm fan on the front (-Y) with wire clips. Movable: fan rotor 'cpu-cooler_fan_rotor' (origin at the hub, spins around the Y axis). No text, no logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
